audit_items.proof_trace: Both `accrue_interest` (L139) and `calculate_borrow_index` (L118) compute `simple_interest_factor = interest_rate.mul_u64(now - last_updated)` where `now` is always derived as `clock.timestamp_ms() / 1000` in every entry point (deposit.move:46, borrow.move:49). `last_updated` is stored at the same second precision, so elapsed time is exact without any block/epoch rounding.
